name: Salomvár (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Salomvár (a blue and green shield with a white castle, with a helm, a lion crest and red, blue and yellow mantling) above the name SALOMVÁR in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Salomvár arms with helm, crest and mantling
